BackendView.description: A backend as returned by the admin API.

agent_claims.description: Agent claims currently synced from this backend.

agents_version.description: Applied version of the `agents` stream (`null` before the first sync).

backend_id.description: The backend's `BACKEND_ID`, checked against `GET /internal/info`; empty = not checked.

prefix_key.description: Public path prefix key: the backend is reachable at `/t/<prefix_key>/`. Generated, immutable.

upstream_url.description: `scheme://host[:port]` nginx proxies to; empty = not routed.

user_claims.description: User claims currently synced from this backend.

users_version.description: Applied version of the `users` stream (`null` before the first sync).

key.description: `entra:<tenant uuid>:<object uuid>` or the agent UUID.

total.description: Claims matching the filter (the list is cut at `limit`).

backends.description: `prefix_key` of every active backend that claims the key.

request_id.description: Same value as the `X-Request-ID` response header.

running.description: A run is in progress in this replica.

NginxMapResult.description: Outcome of rewriting the nginx map (`error` instead of the other fields when it failed).

nginx.description: Last result reported by the nginx watcher; `null` until nginx reports.

id_token.description: Microsoft Entra ID token of the user; its `tid` and `oid` claims give the routing key.

Route.description: A backend a key is routed to.

backend_id.description: The backend's logical id (`BACKEND_ID`); empty when not registered.

prefix.description: Path prefix of the backend on the Router: `/t/<prefix_key>`.

leader.description: This replica runs the stream sync and the scheduler.

info.description: Routes users and agents to their department backend. The routing endpoints are public; the admin API needs the admin account (HTTP Basic). Responses use {"data": ...} and {"error": {"code", "message", "details", "request_id"}}; every response carries X-Request-ID.
